query: UPDATE email SET state = 'approved', html = ?, text = ?, planned_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND task_id = ? AND state = 'review' AND trim(coalesce(subject, '')) <> '' AND trim(coalesce(body_md, '')) <> '' AND mentor_id IN (SELECT id FROM mentor WHERE trashed_at IS NULL AND id IN (SELECT mentor_id FROM mentor_email)) AND task_id IN (SELECT id FROM task WHERE state <> 'stopped')
